2.  **Delivery:** Within 7 days.
3.  **Rating:** At least 6 out of 10.

*   **Orlmere Traders:** Price 195 (Fail, >125), Delivery 11 days (Fail, >7), Rating 3 (Fail, <6).
*   **Holmore Cooperative:** Price 105 (Pass, ≤125), Delivery 5 days (Pass, ≤7), Rating 8 (Pass, ≥6).
*   **Orlcroft Traders:** Price 70 (Pass), Delivery 13 days (Fail, >7), Rating 7 (Pass).
*   **Gardale Cooperative:** Price 135 (Fail, >125), Delivery 20 days (Fail, >7), Rating 4 (Fail, <6).

Only **Holmore Cooperative** meets all three criteria.
